name: tree-view
summary: Graph mode grows rings, not wires
body: The rail rendering answered no user question, so tree mode now draws the outline the stacked-PR world settled on: full-width cards indented under what they build on, guide lines and elbows like a file tree, a #n landing-position badge per row, clickable "+ needs" chips for diamond arms (labels truncate, tooltips keep the evidence), and lineage coloring that only adds — upstream accent, downstream graph-5, nothing dimmed into looking disabled. The toggle reads List | Tree; the legacy graph preference maps to tree.
